title: DISCOVER-Seq: MRE11 ChIP Seq
author: Lilly van de Venn
materials: This section is optional. We like to pre-incubate the magnetic beads with the antibody and then use bead-antibody complexes for the IP. You can however also add the antibody to lysates directly and then collect Antibody-Antigen complexes with beads afterwards. Add 100 μl magnetic beads (Invitrogen, Dynabeads) – protein A to 1.5 ml microfuge tubes. Add 1 ml block solution (0.5% BSA (w/v) in PBS). If you have multiple IPs you can scale up accordingly to the number of IPs. e.g.: 3 IPs: use 300ul of beads (still wash with 1ml of Block solution) Dynabeads Protein A Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #10002D
Analyze your sequencing data using BLENDER software which is available on GitHub. https://github.com/cornlab/blender

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Culture the cell line of interest to obtain 1x10^7 cells for nucleofection (minimum 2x10^6 cells). Set up a control experiment using cells edited with a non-targeting gRNA, processed identically to the sample.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells into a falcon tube and spin down. Wash cells with 1ml PBS, transfer to an eppendorf tube, spin to pellet, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare RNPs
steps.instruction: Prepare Ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complexes using Cas9 Buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM KCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 10% glycerol, and 1 mM TCEP).

substeps.instruction: Add Cas9 Buffer to a final volume of 15uL.
Add 30 pmol of Cas9 per one million cells (e.g., 300pmol for 1x10^7 cells).
Add 30 pmol of sgRNA per one million cells (e.g., 300pmol for 1x10^7 cells).
Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 5-10 minutes or longer.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in Nucleofection Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine RNPs with Lonza nucleofection buffer and supplements, ensuring at least 50% of the total solution is nucleofection buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 60ul of nucleofection buffer to RNPs and pipette up and down.
Transfer the mixture to the eppendorf tube containing cell pellets and resuspend.
Adjust buffer volume based on pellet size (e.g., 1x10^7 cells ~ 40ul pellet + 15ul RNP + 60ul buffer = 115ul total for 100ul cuvettes).

steps.title: Electroporate Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect the cell suspension into a 100ul Lonza nucleofection cuvette and electroporate using a Lonza 4D X nucleofector.

substeps.instruction: Select settings based on cell type (e.g., FF-120 for K562, DJ-110 for B16-F10).

steps.title: Post-Nucleofection Recovery
steps.instruction: Allow cells to sit in the cuvette at RT for 5 minutes. Transfer cells to culture plates with prewarmed complete media and incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Harvest and Preserve Cells
steps.instruction: After 8-24h of culture, harvest cells into a falcon tube and spin to pellet. Discard media.

substeps.instruction: Before spinning, take a small split of cells to keep in culture for gDNA extraction (typically 4 days post-nucleofection) to check off-target mutation rates.

steps.title: Crosslink Cells
steps.instruction: Crosslink cells using formaldehyde to fix proteins to DNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 20ml of room temperature media (IMDM or RPMI) without supplements.
Add 37% Formaldehyde to a final concentration of 1%.
Incubate at RT for 15 min, ensuring a single cell suspension (use a 23G needle for sticky/adherent cells).
Quench formaldehyde by adding 2.5 M glycine to a final concentration of 125mM; leave for a few minutes at RT.

steps.title: Wash and Store Pellets
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with 10 ml ice-cold PBS (1200 g, 3 min spins), discarding supernatant each time. Transfer to a 15 mL falcon tube for the final spin and remove all supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Proceed immediately to lysis or snap freeze pellets in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare MRE11 Antibody-Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the magnetic beads for immunoprecipitation (IP).

substeps.instruction: Collect beads using a magnetic stand and remove supernatant.
Wash beads twice in 1ml block solution (avoid touching beads with pipette tips; use the magnetic stand to move beads through the solution).
Resuspend beads in 250ul block solution per IP and add 4ul of MRE11 antibody (NB100-142).
Incubate for 1-2 hours on a rotating platform at RT.
Wash beads 3 times in 1 ml block solution.
Resuspend in 100 μl block solution for addition to lysate.

steps.title: Lysis and Nuclear Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform sequential lysis to isolate nuclei and chromatin.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend crosslinked pellets in 10 ml LB1 (+protease inhibitors: 50 mM Hepes–KOH pH 7.5, 140 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 10% Glycerol, 0.5% NP-40 or Igepal CA-630, 0.25% Triton X-100, and 100x Halt protease inhibitor cocktail). Rock at 4°C for 10 min.
Spin at 2000 × rcf for 3 min at 4°C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 10 ml LB2 (+protease inhibitors: 10 mM Tris–HCL pH 8.0, 200 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 mM EGTA). Rock gently at 4°C for 5 min.
Pellet nuclei by spinning at 2000 × rcf for 3 min at 4°C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1.5 ml LB3 (+protease inhibitors: 10 mM Tris–HCl pH 8, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.5 mM EGTA, 0.1% Na–Deoxycholate, 0.5% N-lauroylsarcosine) in a 2mL tube.

steps.title: Sonicate Chromatin
steps.instruction: Shear the DNA using sonication to achieve a smear between 200-500bp.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate 3x for 1 min on ice (Settings: 0.9 ON, 0.1 OFF, 75% amplitude), letting samples rest on ice between cycles.
Spin at 20,000 × rcf for 10 min at 4°C to pellet debris.
Transfer supernatant to a new falcon tube.
Add 1.5ml LB3 and 300ul 10% Triton-X (final 1%). Adjust volumes based on number of ChIPs (e.g., for 2 ChIPs, top up to 6 ml with LB3 and Triton X-100 to 1% final).
Mix well and transfer 3mL per IP to 15 ml conical tubes.

steps.title: Perform Immunoprecipitation (IP)
steps.instruction: Capture MRE11-bound DNA using the prepared antibody-bead complex.

substeps.instruction: Save 2x 50 μl of cell lysate from each sonication as input DNA; store at -20°C.
Add 100 μl antibody/magnetic bead mix to cell lysates.
Mix gently on a rotator or rocker at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Wash and Elute ChIP DNA
steps.instruction: Clean the captured complexes and elute the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer half the IP volume to an eppendorf tube, collect beads on magnetic stand, and remove supernatant. Repeat with the remaining IP volume.
Wash beads 6 times with 1 ml RIPA Buffer (50 mM Hepes–KOH pH 7.5, 500 mM LiCl, 1 mM EDTA, 1% NP-40 or Igepal CA-630, 0.7% Na–Deoxycholate).
Wash once with 1 ml TBS (20 mM Tris–HCl pH 7.6, 150 mM NaCl) and remove supernatant.
Add 200 μl elution buffer (50 mM Tris–HCl pH 8, 10 mM EDTA, 1% SDS) and transfer to 1.5ml conical screw cap tubes.

steps.title: Reverse Crosslinking
steps.instruction: Reverse the formaldehyde crosslinks for both IP and input samples.

substeps.instruction: Incubate IP samples at 65°C for 6–18 h with rotation or shaking.
Simultaneously, thaw 50 μl of input lysate, add 150 μl elution buffer, and incubate at 65°C for 6–18 h.

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Isolate and purify the DNA from the reverse-crosslinked samples.

substeps.instruction: Quickspin tubes, collect beads with magnetic stand, and transfer 200 μl of supernatant to a new tube.
Add 100 μl TE to IP and input DNA to dilute SDS.
Add 8 μl of 1 mg/ml RNaseA (Ambion #2271 or Thermo #EN0531); mix and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Add 4 μl of 20 mg/ml proteinase K (Invitrogen 25530-049 or Thermo #EO0491); mix and incubate at 55°C for 1h.
Purify DNA using a Qiagen clean up kit (MinElute PCR #28004 or Reaction Cleanup #28204).
Adjust pH if necessary using 5ul 3M Sodium Acetate (pH 5.2, Thermo #R1181).
Elute DNA in 41ul of purified water.

steps.title: Validate ChIP via qPCR
steps.instruction: Verify enrichment of the target site using quantitative real-time PCR.

substeps.instruction: Amplify a region ~200bp from the cut site and a random control region.
Dilute input DNA 1:49 and IP DNA 1:5.
Expect 80-200-fold enrichment in MRE11 ChIP compared to control for 50-80% indels.

steps.title: Sequencing and Off-Target Analysis
steps.instruction: Proceed to Illumina sequencing and genomic analysis.

substeps.instruction: Perform 100bp paired-end sequencing on a HiSeq4000 (target 12.5 Million reads per sample).
Harvest cells from the preserved split for gDNA extraction and check BLENDER-identified sites for indels using amplicon NGS.
